text.p: - Foreign Minister Davorin Kracun participated for the first time in a meeting of foreign ministers of European Union countries and associate members in Luxembourg on Tuesday.
- German Foreign Minister Klaus Kinkel, visiting Slovenia on Tuesday, said Germany would support Slovenia's efforts to join NATO and EU.
- Inflation rose 0.8 percent in October from September, the Slovenian Statistical Office reported on Tuesday.
- Slovenia's ecological development fund supported the use of natural heating resources with 450 million tolars ($3.3 million) in loans.
- Slovenia beat Denmark 5:0 in an ice-hockey Olympic qualification match in Ljubljana on Tuesday .
- Government to debate ministry of agriculture's proposal to raise milk prices by 10 percent.
- Bank Probanka said nine-month net profit rose five percent to 284 million tolars.
- Chief of staff of the Hungarian Army, General Ferenc Vegh, visited Slovenia on Tuesday and met Slovenian Defence Minister Jelko Kacin.

- Slovenian dailies Delo and Slovenske novice announced plans for a possible merger. A decision will be taken by shareholders at the end of the month. Currently, Delo holds 48 percent of Novice's equity.
